data.title: Royalty Pharma announces $7.5 million gift to Blood Cancer United to expand Therapy Acceleration Program
data.description: In a joint announcement on September 15, 2026, Royalty Pharma and Blood Cancer United revealed a significant development. Royalty Pharma has pledged a generous $7.5 million donation to aid Blood Cancer United's Therapy Acceleration Program (TAP). This initiative is focused on hastening the progress of potential treatments for blood cancer through strategic equity investments and close collaboration with biotech firms. The donation signifies a substantial investment in advancing research and development efforts to combat blood cancer effectively.

data.title: CUPE 1328 to Hold Coffee Truck Event to Mobilize Education Workers and Build Support for Better Schools
data.description: In Toronto, CUPE 1328 will be hosting a coffee truck event at Pope Francis Catholic School with support from OSBCU, OFL, education unions, elected officials, and community members. The event aims to discuss the challenges within Ontario's education system due to chronic underfunding by the Ford government. Key groups involved include CUPE 1328, OSBCU, OFL, and the Ontario School Board Council of Unions. The event will be a platform to raise awareness about the impact of underfunding on public education.

data.title: Skyharbour Partner Company Purecore Commences Data Compilation and Target Generation at The Yurchison Uranium Property
data.description: In Vancouver, BC, a press release was issued on September 15, 2026, stating that Skyharbour Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: SYH) (OTCQX: SYHBF) (Frankfurt: SC1P) announced an update on the Yurchison Uranium Property in the Athabasca Basin, northern Saskatchewan. Partner company Purecore Metals has initiated a comprehensive data compilation and technical review program at the Property. This program aims to gather and analyze historical and modern geological, geochemical, geophysical, and exploration data to create a consolidated project database and geological framework. The dataset will be utilized to pinpoint areas of interest, highlight intersections of technical evidence, and prioritize targets for potential future field exploration.
